text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Digital! What would you 
like for a present?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, for meee...!? I couldn't possibly 
accept...!! I am merely here to analyze, 
after all!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Analysis? Uhh...? Do you know what that 
means, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd be able to decipher it 
logically. Come on, let's hear it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. To analyze something—means you 
need basic information. Unnecessary info 
on the other hand is useless. It just 
becomes noise."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just tell 'em whatever you had for 
breakfast and they'll shut up, won't they? 
...Not that I care.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Today's breakfast menu?! Wh-What godly 
reference material is this...!!?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! It'll be a cinch! I'll send it 
right away!
